It completely omitted the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag and the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code, making the feature unconditionally enabled. It also missed the 1–200 bound on `limit` in validation (allowing 0 and >200), omitted `StoreCannotList`, and skipped the required changes to `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md`.
